challenge.method: Read consecutive history paragraphs and look for an alternate referent for June 1997, including precursor development, ISO/IEC acceptance and a second-edition adoption.
challenge.results: November 1996 refers to the specification development start. The first-edition Ecma adoption is June 1997. April 1998 concerns ISO/IEC approval and June 1998 concerns the Ecma second edition. These adjacent events do not displace the attributed statement.

limitations: This is a documentary attribution to the publisher. General Assembly minutes and an independent historical chronology are outside the evidence for this revision.
